title: OwnershipRegistry not wired to production call sites; bare Context activation still recreates the split-brain
description: f4b089027c added rust/lichen-oscore/src/ownership.rs but enforcement is opt-in: rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:1016-1018 activates via bare Context::restore_existing/register_fresh and rust/lichen-node/src/secure.rs:542-549 via register_fresh_context — lib.rs:65-67 documents bare methods remain unguarded. Two separate registry instances, or one registry plus any bare call, recreate the concurrent-receiver split-brain the bead v0ee set out to close. Fix: migrate gateway.rs and node secure.rs activation paths through OwnershipRegistry (or deprecate/private the bare methods so the contract is enforced where traffic flows).
